correctness.rationale: The current graph theorem sends product monomials to colored cliques and finite meets to disjoint unions. A right clique covers a left clique under a partial color-preserving map exactly under coordinatewise exponent domination. Requiring the map to be total adds exactly right-support inclusion in left support. Mutual criteria give equality of minimal upward-closure generators, plus support equality in the ordinary case. An exhaustive finite map enumeration agreed in 1242 checked cases.

originality.rationale: The 2024 source proves the general graph characterization and unrestricted complexity but does not state the coordinatewise monomial-meet specialization. Targeted literature searches and repeated semantic overlap searches found no equivalent or stronger canonical-antichain criterion. The conclusion remains best-of-knowledge rather than exhaustive.

value.rationale: The result supplies a closed necessary-and-sufficient arithmetic criterion, a canonical semantic normal form, and a polynomial-time decision procedure for a natural infinite fragment of a generally Sigma-2-p-complete universal-validity problem, while sharply identifying the additional support datum needed for ordinary total reductions.
